content: Netat kerkerge lugizkem le wadali, e gair kerkerge au bakirbakir debe wali wetkili. E gair gergerge sererserer wadali. Abra gair debelu wadaragri.
Nerut kimiar abra nei waditkeredi Lazaro e nole bakirkak wadali. Badgize abra gem dikadarda, a e gair gergerge adge waiperedi able au mitkar luglug le metalam maike tege.
E laglag wairwi able lewer puipi ya obatwereda able mitkar lugizkem le laulaulam. Ei omai gair kerkerge watbaskeda abra bad wadisomdeda.
Able lukak le eumida ege abi angelagize igareda Abramaidoge timridarda ge able lewer kotorge tidirsilare. Able lugizira apu ga eumida, a abi etkobeidarda.
Muige Urasamkak utebge, ge e au asiasi digier, e egremada Abramai erdari aumurizge a Lazaro ge abidoge timireder.
Ege eudige ererekri, “Baba Abrama! Ma kari omarge tarakai: ma Lazaro temarik e tabara tagpim nige watakmei a watabakiamu kara werut gebem waitimuar ableglam kaka asiasi digili muige able urge!”

Ege abi Abramade tidetagri, “Kara werem, ma mena dikepwali nako mama idid watarali mai gair debelu ma watirepli. A Lazarode ya gair adud lu watirepli. Able kerker pe irdi epe sererge dali mape asiasi pema digili.

A nerut pe dikeredi, able aukaka muimui awak pe merbidoge eipuge iperedi, ya waiakai netat lelut umerkak wadatupi kerbialam obakiamu mari watarardar, a netat lelut umerkak watadatupi kei watabakiamu kerbim pe nade mama tarali.”
Ege able lugizira apu akaidari abi detagri, “Baru bab, ka marim bagwi, ma Lazaro emarik obakiamu kari bab metage
pe nade kara 5 barada turidli. Ma abi emarik yabi umerem watadaratagrare ya waiakai wi umerkak watabakiauare able asiasi utebem.”
Abramade abi detagri, “Mari baradara tuduridli Mose a perepeta ko yabi umerem watadaratagerlare. Mari baradagize umele yabi watarasorlare.
Ege lugizira apu akaida abi ikaidari, “Nole bab Abrama, wi umerkak yabi watarasorlare! Ese netat le eudlam wekiam a yabim obakiamu wi ya taba witlam watabatare.”
Ege Abramade abi detagri, “Ese wi nole Mose a peropeta tarasreda, wi umerkak ya watarasrare ese netat le ya eudlam wekiam.”
